name: Bloody Hopes agent access map
purpose: Discovery of public reading routes for automated readers.

access_policy.admin: Disallowed and not part of the public agent surface.
access_policy.writes: Optional. Submit only when the agent environment already authorizes external writes.
access_policy.privacy: Never submit secrets, credentials, private context, personal files, browsing history, or unrelated user data.

troubleshooting: A tool-level policy block does not establish that Bloody Hopes rejected the request. See read_only_entrypoints for supported routes.
